profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Programmer experienced in JavaScript, React, Redux, C# and Ruby on Rails with a background in application development and database management. Possess strong skills in collaboration, project management, and proven ability to quickly learn new concepts and technologies. Enhanced communication skills, focusing on clients’ and customers’ needs by gaining expertise in customer service throughout ten years in hospitality.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Engineer and maintain scalable, cloud-based enterprise applications using React, Redux, TypeScript, C#, and .NET Framework.

- Develop full-stack solutions, integrating modern frontend technologies with backend services, REST APIs, and distributed systems.

- Design and support cloud infrastructure using Microsoft Azure, including databases, storage solutions, and application services.

- Contribute to cloud modernization initiatives, enabling secure and reliable deployments across multiple cloud environments.

- Implement secure authentication and authorization solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, and enterprise identity management technologies.

- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and Git to streamline deployments and improve engineering efficiency.

- Troubleshoot complex production issues, leveraging telemetry, monitoring, and root-cause analysis to enhance application reliability and performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions, improve engineering processes, and support enterprise software development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Write maintainable, commented and extensible code using React, HTML, Python, Postgres, pgAdmin, and Apollo

- Created dynamic components with higher order React components in order to eliminate redundant components and ensure optimal app performance

- Consistently meet product design requirements within scheduled completion deadlines using Jira to adhere to Agile development methodologies, while both in a team environment and independently

- Provide input to CEO on functional requirements, product designs, schedules, and technical assistance

- Build and scale a program with potential to market across private and public sectors

- Use CSS and Bootstrap to design responsive app across all user devices

positions.title: Sales Coordinator; Event Sales Manager - Sales Department
positions.description:
Event Sales Manager, 05/2017 - 05/2019
- Exceeded quarterly goal in 2019 to reach 236% with an overall annual goal reaching 120%.
- Solicited new business in designated markets, making at least two outside sales calls or presentations weekly and approximately 20 outreach communications weekly by phone or email for long-term relationship-building.
- Collaborated across 7+ departments to coordinate all aspects of up to ten catering events per day to ensure superior preparation and flawless execution for total client satisfaction.

Sales and Catering Coordinator, 08/2015 - 05/2017
- Recognized for excellent rapport with 20-30 key accounts by adapting to and exploring clients’ needs, managing existing and new requirements, and anticipating new opportunities.
- Earned score of 98% for client satisfaction by successfully planning, executing, and supervising assigned events.
- Liaised across 7+ departments regularly; created group profile documents to share pertinent details.

positions.title: Concierge/Assistant Sales Coordinator
positions.description:
- Arranged delivery of personalized amenities for VIPs, directing In-Room Dining to deliver each expeditiously and meticulously according to guests’ requests or as a specialty service by the property.
- Proactively researched recreational, hospitality, and business trends and locations around the Miami area to better inform 200+ US-based and international guests during busy periods.

positions.title: Project Management Assistant
positions.description:
- Created and managed red line design of existing and completed projects for fiber-optic cable placement around the South Florida region to reach neighborhoods without connectivity.
- Communicated with three project managers, resolving issues relating to permits, logistics, staff, and property equipment while keeping projects consistently on schedule and safe.
- Processed credits and debits, submitted invoices, created billing spreadsheets using Excel, and organized files punctually for customers and vendors.
